common_contract.decision_state_sampling: use only predeclared Phase 9B slots that occur while the episode is active; never move or replace an unavailable slot
common_contract.termination: goal completion, declared horizon, or typed terminal failure

S0_SCRIPTED_DIAGNOSTIC.action_source: Phase 6 local controller plus safety projection
S0_SCRIPTED_DIAGNOSTIC.communication: normal episode communication; not used to select script events
S0_SCRIPTED_DIAGNOSTIC.retry: none; skipped or blocked script entries are not moved
S0_SCRIPTED_DIAGNOSTIC.topology_behavior: scripted desired topology follows the frozen smooth transition profile; offline oracle bypasses Phase 7 agreement but never safety projection

S1_ALWAYS_COMPACT.action_source: Phase 6 COMPACT local controller plus safety projection
S1_ALWAYS_COMPACT.hold_semantics: continue mission and obstacle response in COMPACT
S1_ALWAYS_COMPACT.topology_behavior: COMPACT remains committed for the complete episode

S2_ALWAYS_LINE.action_source: Phase 6 local controller plus safety projection
S2_ALWAYS_LINE.hold_semantics: LINE remains committed for the complete episode
S2_ALWAYS_LINE.topology_behavior: at time zero use the offline forced-topology qualification interface to initialize LINE role targets; no online request or epoch is created

S3_FROZEN_LOCAL_GEOMETRIC_SELECTOR.action_source: Phase 6 controller plus safety projection in committed topology
S3_FROZEN_LOCAL_GEOMETRIC_SELECTOR.compact_to_line_rule: after evidence_persistence, request LINE iff measured width is at least LINE required width and less than COMPACT required width+spacing_margin
S3_FROZEN_LOCAL_GEOMETRIC_SELECTOR.line_to_compact_rule: after evidence_persistence, request COMPACT iff complete observation is open or measured width >= COMPACT required width+2*spacing_margin
local_inputs: local COMPACT and LINE role metadata
S3_FROZEN_LOCAL_GEOMETRIC_SELECTOR.origination: each robot may originate only on its own threshold crossing; an adopted active intent suppresses later local origins
S3_FROZEN_LOCAL_GEOMETRIC_SELECTOR.transition: every request uses Phase 7 readiness, agreement, confirmation and profile
S3_FROZEN_LOCAL_GEOMETRIC_SELECTOR.unknown_behavior: hold current topology and emit no intent
S3_FROZEN_LOCAL_GEOMETRIC_SELECTOR.width_statistic: minimum free inner-surface separation from paired left/right boundary supports in the role-dependent lookahead sector

S4_FROZEN_TRANSITION_PROTOCOL.abort_rearm: unchanged Phase 7 abort and rearm rules; no event retry
S4_FROZEN_TRANSITION_PROTOCOL.candidate_selection: the one candidate named by the scheduled local event
S4_FROZEN_TRANSITION_PROTOCOL.lifecycle_origination: role-0000 only; propagation and all decisions remain leaderless
S4_FROZEN_TRANSITION_PROTOCOL.local_event_source: role-0000 local mission clock at 0.25*horizon requests LINE and at 0.65*horizon requests COMPACT if different from committed topology
S4_FROZEN_TRANSITION_PROTOCOL.transition: complete Phase 7 intent, score, readiness, all-ready, confirmation, profile and dwell

S5_BOUNDED_PERTURBATION.action_source: S1 action plus one bounded pre-projection acceleration perturbation
S5_BOUNDED_PERTURBATION.event_eligibility: all predeclared active slots, including but not moved toward the perturbation
S5_BOUNDED_PERTURBATION.invalidity: record invalid without resampling if perturbed command is nonfinite
S5_BOUNDED_PERTURBATION.perturbation_target: one robot selected by seed modulo team size
S5_BOUNDED_PERTURBATION.seed: source_job.seeds.initial_condition with S5 perturbation draw keys
S5_BOUNDED_PERTURBATION.start_time: first control tick at or after 0.40*episode_horizon_seconds
